entryPoints: upbound at Cap St. Michel, downbound at Cape Vincent

typical.basis: Recent official notices: openings March 22 in 2025 and 2026 and targeted for 2027; regular entries without special agreement ended December 24 in the 2025 and 2026 seasons; all ships clear by January 5 for the 2025 and 2026 seasons (January 10 for 2024). Used only when a season has no official dates loaded below, and always labelled as typical.

source.title: Seaway Notice #9 (2026), Closing of the 2026 Navigation Season

2027.openingNote: Targeted opening date from Seaway Notice #9 (2026); no hour given, 08:00 Eastern (the 2026 opening hour) is used as the state boundary.

winterHarbourSource.title: Seaway Notice #14 (2025), Closing of the 2025 Navigation Season
winterHarbourSource.notes: Ports east of the Seaway (St. Lambert Lock) on the St. Lawrence River remain open to navigation during the winter months.

upkeep: Optional each year: add the new season's official dates under seasons.<year> when the Seaway publishes its opening (about February) and closing (about October) notices. Without them the page keeps working on the typical schedule, labelled as typical.
